name: filetree
description: A file tree of what Claude touches: what it is doing now, the files it touched this turn, and git status

activity.title: Claude activity
activity.description: Which activity lights up in the tree: reads (Read, or readers such as rg, grep, cat) in blue, writes in orange, git work in green

glyphs.title: Icons
glyphs.description: auto: Nerd Font icons when one is installed (not in the desktop app); plain: Unicode only

follow.title: Follow Claude
follow.description: on: the tree scrolls to the file Claude reads, writes or commits. off: the view moves only when you scroll; highlights still show.

column.title: Right column
column.description: What the right column shows by default: date (last change) or size (file size; for folders, disk usage worked out in the background). The button in the header switches it.
